$description: Semantic colours (tier 2), light mode. The default values; color.dark.json overrides every one of them for dark mode. A value is a hex colour, a reference, or a mix of two (see README, "Derived colours").

canvas.$description: App/page background: the grouped grey (true black in dark). iOS: systemGroupedBackground. M3: surface.

surface.$description: Cards, list rows, inputs. iOS: secondarySystemGroupedBackground. M3: surfaceContainerLowest.

raised.$description: Sheets, dialogs, menus, the thumb of a segmented control. M3: surfaceContainerHigh.

subtle.$description: Quiet fills inside a card: read-only fields, table stripes. M3: surfaceContainer.

primary.$description: The label colour, and the mode's ink for mixed colours.

secondary.$description: Secondary text in the native apps: the prototype's grey as one opaque value. The one exception to 4.5:1 (ADR-032): 3.3:1 on the canvas, 3.7:1 on cards, declared only as native-secondary-text pairs. Tertiary text and placeholders use it too. Web uses color.web.* instead.

link.$description: Text buttons and links: the accent as text.

default.$description: Decorative separators only (hairlines between rows). Not used for control boundaries.

control.$description: Input and control outlines: 3:1 non-text contrast (WCAG 1.4.11).

focus.$description: Focus ring, 2px + 2px offset on web. Native uses the platform focus system.

decorative.$description: Decorative marks only: chevrons and the sheet handle (the prototype's lighter label). Outside the contrast pairs; never for text.

fill.$description: Move pink as a fill. Anything on it uses color.accent.on.

on.$description: The on-accent colour: text and icons on an accent fill.

text.$description: The accent as text and icons on the canvas and cards.

gradient-top.$description: Top of an accent gradient: the accent mixed with black, 85%.

bg.$description: Filled buttons. iOS: app tint/accentColor. M3: primary.
Secondary/tonal buttons, selected chips, selected tab indicator. M3: secondaryContainer.
Destructive confirm (cancel class) with white text: the danger colour mixed with black, 85%, because the pure colour is 3.57:1 with white. iOS: role .destructive. M3: error.

solid.$description: Private sessions (PRODUCT.md section 16). Always paired with a text label; colour is never the only signal. Calendar bar/dot.

fg.$description: Glyphs and icons on the tint, on cards and on the canvas: the colour mixed with the mode's ink, 78%. 3:1 for graphics; not for text on the tint (use text).

text.$description: Text in this colour on the tint, on cards and on the canvas (prototype: the colour mixed with the ink, 42% in light, 55% in dark). 4.5:1.

bg.$description: The tint: the colour at 15% (light) or 30% (dark) on a card.

on-solid.$description: Glyphs on the gradient. White never sits on the unmixed colour.

gradient-top.$description: Top of the fill: the colour mixed with black, 85%.

cyan.$description: Workspace dot colours, picked automatically from the workspace ID (workspaceColour in TypeScript, workspaceColor on native). 3:1 on cards and the canvas in both modes.

background.$description: The trainer web's shadcn/ui zinc neutrals (web only; the native apps don't generate them). Secondary text there is zinc's 71717A / A1A1AA (ADR-032).

muted.$description: The trainer web's quiet fill (hover, skeletons). zinc 75 rather than 100 so that muted-foreground keeps 4.5:1 on it; the web ticket may settle both differently.

secondary.$description: Secondary text on the client web: darker than the apps' grey so it meets WCAG 2.2 AA (ADR-032). Web only.

bg.$description: Glass surfaces for the client web: a hex colour with alpha (the one place the source allows it). Never in a contrast pair.
